table.name: Ignition Cut - Switch Input
table.description: Arms the standalone Ignition Cut V18 limiter at the proven six-channel P1L final-stage charge gate. Launch Control V18 owns a separate request to the same installed cut engine and does not depend on this switch.

table.name: Ignition Cut - RPM Limit
table.description: Spark-cut threshold stored as RPM/32. Example: 6880 RPM = raw 0xD7.

table.name: Ignition Cut - RPM Hysteresis
table.description: Standalone limiter only. Once cutting starts, spark resumes below Cut RPM minus this value. Raw 0xFF preserves the legacy zero-hysteresis behavior and displays as 0 RPM; raw 0x00 also selects zero hysteresis.

table.name: Ignition Cut - Fixed Injector Pulse Width
Pulse Width While Spark Is Cut

table.description: Standalone limiter only. Overrides base injector pulse width before native latency and cylinder correction while its spark-cut request is active. Raw 0xFFFF preserves stock injection and displays as -0.00534 ms; entering -0.00534 writes the stock sentinel. Raw 0x0000 means zero base width, not injector disable. Uses native fueling if the requested pulse cannot fit the validated timing interval. Native fuel shutoffs remain active. Launch ignition mode has its own fixed-IPW setting.

table.name: LC - Switch / Mode
table.description: Arms Launch Control V18. Always acts as an asserted input and uses the same speed and throttle gates as clutch modes: arm below Arm Speed with TPS at or above Min TPS, retain the latch during rollout, and release at Max Speed or below Min TPS. After release, Always can rearm only below Arm Speed.

table.name: LC - Cut Type
table.description: Fuel mode uses the native staged limiter with independent soft and hard RPM thresholds. Ignition mode owns a separate request to the installed Ignition Cut V18 engine; the standalone Ignition Cut switch may remain off.

table.name: LC - Clutch Polarity
table.description: Electrical sense of the clutch or toggle input. Always mode ignores this setting. Releasing the input retains an armed latch until the speed or throttle release condition.

table.name: LC - Soft Cut RPM
table.description: Launch soft threshold stored as RPM/32. Fuel mode uses the lower of this value and the native soft limit, independently of Hard Cut RPM. Fuel-return thresholds use this effective soft RPM, retaining native staging. Ignition mode requests spark cut at this setting and ignores Hard Cut RPM. Example: 4000 RPM = raw 0x7D.

table.name: LC - Hard Cut RPM

table.name: LC - Fuel Hysteresis B (Gradual Recovery)
Gradual Recovery Below Fuel Threshold By

table.description: Launch fuel mode only. Gradual recovery begins below effective soft RPM minus B, floored at zero, unless Hysteresis A already clears the limiter. Values 0 through 8128 RPM override B only. Raw 0xFF displays as 8160 RPM and means Follow stock: use the tune's native Hysteresis B. A and B are independent; no ordering is enforced. Native limiter protection takes priority. Ignition mode ignores this setting.

table.name: LC - Fuel Hysteresis A (Immediate Clear)
Immediate Clear Below Fuel Threshold By

table.name: LC - Ignition RPM Hysteresis

table.name: LC - Max Speed

table.name: LC - Min TPS
table.description: Continuous throttle-angle gate (exact MS41.0 ID41 scale). Dropping below this value immediately clears the launch latch.

table.name: LC - Fuel-Cut Ignition Angle
table.description: Launch V18 fuel mode only. Optional absolute scheduled angle, from -23.625 to 0 degrees BTDC in 0.375-degree steps; a negative angle is after TDC. The final angle is the later of this setting and native protected timing. Knock reference filtering, correction and learning wait through actual cut or modified-timing episodes and fresh-sample recovery. An eligible angle that never changes an event does not start this hold. Ignition-cut mode ignores it. Native dwell and spark event scheduling remain in control. Ordinary requested-angle telemetry does not report this final scheduling override.

table.description: Spark-cut threshold stored as RPM/32. Example: 6880 RPM = raw 0xD7.

table.name: Ignition Cut - RPM Hysteresis
table.description: Standalone limiter only. Once cutting starts, spark resumes below Cut RPM minus this value. Raw 0xFF preserves the legacy zero-hysteresis behavior and displays as 0 RPM; raw 0x00 also selects zero hysteresis.

table.name: Ignition Cut - Fixed Injector Pulse Width
Pulse Width While Spark Is Cut

table.description: Standalone limiter only. Overrides base injector pulse width before native latency and cylinder correction while its spark-cut request is active. Raw 0xFFFF preserves stock injection and displays as -0.00534 ms; entering -0.00534 writes the stock sentinel. Raw 0x0000 means zero base width, not injector disable. Uses native fueling if the requested pulse cannot fit the validated timing interval. Native fuel shutoffs remain active. Launch ignition mode has its own fixed-IPW setting.

table.name: LC - Switch / Mode
table.description: Arms Launch Control V18. Always acts as an asserted input and uses the same speed and throttle gates as clutch modes: arm below Arm Speed with TPS at or above Min TPS, retain the latch during rollout, and release at Max Speed or below Min TPS. After release, Always can rearm only below Arm Speed.

table.name: LC - Cut Type
table.description: Fuel mode uses the native staged limiter with independent soft and hard RPM thresholds. Ignition mode owns a separate request to the installed Ignition Cut V18 engine; the standalone Ignition Cut switch may remain off.

table.name: LC - Clutch Polarity
table.description: Electrical sense of the clutch or toggle input. Always mode ignores this setting. Releasing the input retains an armed latch until the speed or throttle release condition.

table.name: LC - Soft Cut RPM
table.description: Launch soft threshold stored as RPM/32. Fuel mode uses the lower of this value and the native soft limit, independently of Hard Cut RPM. Fuel-return thresholds use this effective soft RPM, retaining native staging. Ignition mode requests spark cut at this setting and ignores Hard Cut RPM. Example: 4000 RPM = raw 0x7D.

table.name: LC - Hard Cut RPM
table.description: Independent fuel-mode hard threshold stored as RPM/32. It may be below Soft Cut RPM; fuel-return thresholds still derive from effective soft RPM. Native staged-cut and hysteresis logic remains in control. The effective hard threshold never exceeds the native hard limit. Raw 0xFF selects Soft Cut RPM + 96 RPM with saturation and the same native ceiling. Ignition mode ignores this setting.

table.name: LC - Fuel Hysteresis B (Gradual Recovery)
Gradual Recovery Below Fuel Threshold By

table.description: Launch fuel mode only. Gradual recovery begins below effective soft RPM minus B, floored at zero, unless Hysteresis A already clears the limiter. Values 0 through 8128 RPM override B only. Raw 0xFF displays as 8160 RPM and means Follow stock: use the tune's native Hysteresis B. A and B are independent; no ordering is enforced. Native limiter protection takes priority. Ignition mode ignores this setting.

table.name: LC - Fuel Hysteresis A (Immediate Clear)
Immediate Clear Below Fuel Threshold By

table.description: Launch fuel mode only. The limiter clears immediately below effective soft RPM minus A, floored at zero. This check takes priority over gradual recovery. Values 0 through 8128 RPM override A only. Raw 0xFF displays as 8160 RPM and means Follow stock: use the tune's native Hysteresis A. A and B are independent; no ordering is enforced. Native limiter protection takes priority. Ignition mode ignores this setting.

table.name: LC - Ignition RPM Hysteresis
table.description: Launch ignition mode only. Once spark cut starts, it resumes below Soft Cut RPM minus this value. Raw 0xFF and 0x00 both select and display as zero hysteresis. A hysteresis value at or above Soft Cut RPM also uses zero hysteresis at runtime. Fuel mode ignores this setting.

table.name: LC - Ignition Fixed Injector Pulse Width
Pulse Width During Launch Spark Cut

table.description: Launch ignition mode only. Overrides base injector pulse width before native latency and cylinder correction while the launch spark-cut request is active. Raw 0xFFFF preserves stock injection and displays as -0.00534 ms; entering -0.00534 writes the stock sentinel. Raw 0x0000 means zero base width, not injector disable. Uses native fueling if the requested pulse cannot fit the validated timing interval. Native fuel shutoffs remain active. This value wins if both spark-cut requests are active. Fuel mode ignores it.

table.name: LC - Arm Speed
table.description: Near-standstill arming guard for Always and clutch modes. Set at least 1 km/h; 1 km/h permits arming only at a reported integer speed of 0 km/h. Raw zero cannot arm a cleared latch. At or above Arm Speed, an existing latch is retained until Max Speed or the throttle release condition.

table.name: LC - Max Speed
table.description: Releases the launch latch once vehicle speed reaches this value. Must be greater than Arm Speed.

table.name: LC - Min TPS
table.description: Continuous throttle gate. Dropping below this value immediately clears the launch latch.

table.name: LC - Fuel-Cut Ignition Angle
table.description: Launch V18 fuel mode only. Optional absolute scheduled angle, from -23.625 to 0 degrees BTDC in 0.375-degree steps; a negative angle is after TDC. Raw 0xFF means Off and displays as 72 degrees, outside the supported custom range. Other positive values are invalid and disable the override. Starts at the first effective launch soft or hard threshold. Holds through the launch fuel-cut episode until all fuel has returned and RPM is below that first threshold. Continuous input release or speed/throttle release ends the override; native limiter priority and critical input or knock-sensor faults retain normal timing. The final angle is the later of this setting and native protected timing. Knock reference filtering, correction and learning wait through actual cut or modified-timing episodes and fresh-sample recovery. An eligible angle that never changes an event does not start this hold. Ignition-cut mode ignores it. Native dwell and spark event scheduling remain in control. Ordinary requested-angle telemetry does not report this final scheduling override.

table.name: Ignition Cut - Retard Range
table.description: Standalone limiter only. Fixed ignition timing begins at RPM Limit minus this range, including firing between cuts. The initial range is 192 RPM. An enabled angle requires a positive range smaller than the cut RPM; invalid ranges disable this timing override. This range does not change RPM hysteresis or fuel delivery.

table.name: Ignition Cut - Fixed Ignition Angle
Absolute Angle In Ignition Retard Range

table.description: Standalone limiter only. Optional absolute scheduled ignition angle in the configured retard range, from -23.625 to 0 degrees BTDC in 0.375-degree steps. Negative values are after TDC; zero is TDC. This is a fixed angle, not a subtraction from normal timing. Raw FF means Off and displays as 72; other positive angles disable the override. Native faults and limiter priority retain their veto. The final angle is the later of this setting and native protected timing. Knock reference filtering, correction and learning wait through actual cut or modified-timing episodes and fresh-sample recovery. An eligible angle that never changes an event does not start this hold. Native dwell and coil scheduling remain in control. Existing launch fuel-cut ignition angle remains independent.

table.name: LC - Ignition Retard Range
table.description: Launch ignition mode only. Fixed ignition timing begins at Soft Cut RPM minus this range, including firing between cuts. The initial range is 192 RPM. An enabled angle requires a positive range smaller than the cut RPM; invalid ranges disable this timing override. This range does not change RPM hysteresis or fuel delivery.

Native faults and limiter priority retain their veto. The final angle is the later of this setting and native protected timing. Knock reference filtering, correction and learning wait through actual cut or modified-timing episodes and fresh-sample recovery. An eligible angle that never changes an event does not start this hold. Native dwell and coil scheduling remain in control. Existing launch fuel-cut ignition angle remains independent.
